name: Bambu Studio
what: Bambu Lab's desktop slicer, with a documented command line. It slices for Bambu printers, the P2S from version 2.3.0, and writes a sliced 3MF that holds the G-code for each plate. From its interface it can also send a job to a printer over the cloud or the LAN.
install: The user installs the desktop app from Bambu Lab or the project's GitHub releases. The command line is the same binary.
firstCall: bambu-studio --help, to confirm the installed version and its flags
evidenceNote: On 2026-11-27 the command-line wiki page, the release notes for 2.3.0 and the repository README were read. AGPL-3.0, based on PrusaSlicer. exposes is true because the app can send jobs to the maker's cloud; the command-line slice itself sends nothing. No slice ran in a GDH session.
